exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Getting Ready for a Typhoon
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mum: A strong typhoon is coming tonight, so we need to get ready.
Tom: What should we do first, Mum?
Mum: First, help me move these flower pots inside so the wind can't throw them around.
Tom: Done. Should I fill some bottles with water too?
Mum: Yes, good thinking. The water may be cut off for a day or two.
Tom: I'll also find the radio and put in fresh batteries.
Mum: Perfect. If the power goes out, the radio will tell us when it is safe.
Tom: I feel much safer now that we are prepared.
exercises.translation_cn: 妈妈说今晚有强台风要做好准备;先把花盆搬进屋,免得被风吹得到处乱飞;Tom 还往瓶子里装水,因为可能停水一两天;并找出收音机换上新电池;停电时收音机能告诉他们何时安全;Tom 觉得做了准备安心多了。

questions.stem: What is coming tonight?
Why does Mum want to move the flower pots inside?
options: So the wind cannot throw them around.
To sell them the next day.

questions.stem: Why do they fill bottles with water?
options: The water may be cut off for a day or two.
They want to wash the car.
They are going on a long trip.

questions.stem: What does Tom do with the radio?
options: He sells it to a neighbour.
He puts fresh batteries in it.
He turns it off for good.

questions.stem: How does Tom feel at the end?
options: Much safer now that they are prepared.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 What to Do in an Earthquake
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: If an earthquake strikes while you are indoors, do not run outside at once.
Get under a strong table and hold on until the shaking stops.
Stay away from the windows, because the glass may break.
If you are driving, slow down and stop the car in an open place.
After the shaking stops, leave the building calmly and check for danger.
exercises.translation_cn: 若地震时你在室内,别马上往外跑;躲到结实的桌子下并抓牢,直到摇晃停止;远离窗户,因为玻璃可能碎裂;若在开车,减速并把车停在开阔处;摇晃停止后镇定地离开建筑并检查危险。

questions.stem: What should you NOT do when an earthquake strikes indoors?
Where should you take cover?
Why should you stay away from windows?
What should a driver do?
options: Slow down and stop in an open place.

questions.stem: What should you do after the shaking stops?
options: Leave the building calmly and check for danger.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Building a Survival Kit
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lily: Our teacher asked us to make a survival kit at home. Where do we start?
Dad: Good idea. First, we need food and clean water for at least three days.
Lily: How much water is that?
Dad: About three litres for each person every day.
Lily: I'll add a torch and some spare batteries as well.
Dad: Don't forget a first-aid box and a whistle to call for help.
Lily: Should we keep a dust mask too?
Dad: Yes, and put everything in a bag that is easy to carry.
exercises.translation_cn: Lily 的老师让大家在家做一个求生包,她问从哪开始;爸爸说先要至少三天的食物和干净水;每人每天约三升水;Lily 还要加手电筒和备用电池;爸爸提醒别忘急救箱和求救哨子;还要口罩;最后把所有东西装进易携带的包里。

questions.stem: What did Lily's teacher ask the class to do?
options: Make a survival kit at home.

questions.stem: How much food and water do they need at first?
options: Enough for at least three days.

questions.stem: How much water does each person need a day?
What does Dad say they need to call for help?
Where should they put everything?
options: In a bag that is easy to carry.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Floods
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Floods are one of the most common natural disasters in the world.
They are usually caused by heavy rain that lasts for many days.
When you hear a flood warning, leave for higher ground at once.
Never try to walk or drive through fast-moving water.
Keep your important papers in a waterproof bag, just in case.
exercises.translation_cn: 洪水是世界上最常见的自然灾害之一;通常由连日暴雨引起;听到洪水警报要立刻往高处转移;切勿步行或开车穿过湍急的水流;把重要文件放进防水袋,以防万一。

questions.stem: How common are floods?
options: They are one of the most common disasters.

questions.stem: What usually causes floods?
What should you do when you hear a flood warning?
options: Leave for higher ground at once.

questions.stem: What should you never do?
options: Walk or drive through fast-moving water.

questions.stem: Where should you keep important papers?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 After the Storm
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Reporter: Excuse me, can you tell me what happened here last night?
Resident: A typhoon hit our town and the wind was terribly strong.
Reporter: Was anyone hurt?
Resident: Luckily not. We had all moved to the school hall before it came.
Reporter: How did you know it was time to leave?
Resident: We heard the evacuation order on the radio.
Reporter: And what are people doing now?
Resident: We are clearing the streets and helping our neighbours repair their roofs.
exercises.translation_cn: 记者问昨晚这里发生了什么;居民说台风袭击了小镇,风非常猛;幸好无人受伤,因为台风来临前大家都去了学校礼堂;他们是从收音机听到撤离令才知道该走;现在人们正在清理街道、帮邻居修屋顶。

questions.stem: What hit the town last night?
Was anyone hurt?
options: No, luckily no one was hurt.

questions.stem: Where had the residents gone before the storm?
options: To the basement of a shop.

questions.stem: How did they know it was time to leave?
options: A neighbour knocked on the door.
They heard the evacuation order on the radio.

questions.stem: What are people doing now?
options: Clearing the streets and helping repair roofs.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Wildfire Safety
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Wildfires can spread very quickly and destroy everything in their path.
If you are caught in one, cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth.
Move towards a river, a pond or any open water if you can.
Stay low to the ground, where the air is cleaner and cooler.
Most of all, stay calm and listen for instructions from the firefighters.
exercises.translation_cn: 野火蔓延极快,摧毁沿途一切;若被困其中,用湿布捂住口鼻;尽量往河流、池塘或任何开阔水域移动;贴近地面,那里空气更干净、更凉;最重要的是保持冷静,听消防员的指示。

questions.stem: How do wildfires spread?
What should you cover your nose and mouth with?
Where should you try to move?
options: Towards the centre of the fire.
Towards a river, pond or open water.

questions.stem: Why stay low to the ground?
options: The air there is cleaner and cooler.

questions.stem: What is most important of all?
options: Shout as loudly as you can.
Stay calm and listen to the firefighters.
